T23.title: Five conditionally feasible plans and Pareto comparison
T23.inputs: All 84 permitted plans. Tests: growth <=80 lakh, March EBITDA >=0, March returns <=6%, B1 proxy for claims controls.

definitions.sort: descending unrounded Q1 EBITDA; team objective
definitions.pareto_efficient: no other feasible plan has no higher growth money, no lower March/Q1 EBITDA, and no higher return rate, with at least one strict gain
definitions.conditional_pass: Exhibit 5 operating controls remain to be demonstrated

T24.title: March EBITDA by combined order uplift and Good battery swap share

definitions.row_axis: combined order uplift, applied once as 1+u
definitions.column_axis: Good battery replacement share g, per delivered Good cost g*1000
definitions.march_ebitda_lakh: delivered contribution less 99 channel fixed, 58 company fixed and 9 shift; report/batteries/claims/returns/commission included
definitions.break_even_rows: exact uplift root holds Good swaps at 40%
definitions.break_even_columns: exact Good swap root holds uplift at 16.64%; their intersection need not be zero

T25.title: Third shift timing and Q1 consequences
T25.inputs: B1+B2 setups 40 lakh in January; shift 9 lakh each active month; January unchanged.

definitions.q1_delta_vs_feb_shift_lakh: alternative Q1 EBITDA minus February shift Q1 EBITDA
definitions.conditional_pass: all four numerical screen fields, with claims proxy conditional

T26.title: Segment ranking sensitivity to stated judgement weights

inputs.basis: Inherited T10 team judgement, 1 weak to 5 strong. Size order follows E1C; contribution and capacity follow E2/E4/E6. No measured segment-specific demand elasticity is available.

definitions.rank: 1 + number of strictly larger totals; ties share rank

T27.title: Proposed weekly operating definitions and response levels

definitions.status: All owners, cohort conventions, warning periods and actions are proposed management rules, not observed performance. Monthly board tests remain authoritative.
definitions.warning_vs_boundary: 50% Good swaps is a warning; the model boundary is about 55%. Return 6% is a board boundary and is not an EBITDA zero point.

rows.definition: All-channel delivered phones in the completed week; monthly comparison divided by 4.33.
rows.boundary_type: March EBITDA zero at base mix and costs
rows.proposed_action: If below this level for two completed weeks, diagnose channel demand and delivery loss; preserve claims controls and retest the full-month forecast.

rows.definition: Phones returned within seven days divided by phones delivered in the same fully matured sales cohort, aggregated across channels. Exclude immature cohorts.
rows.boundary_type: March board test limit; not EBITDA zero
rows.proposed_action: At 5.5%, inspect grade/channel cohorts and pause misleading creative; at 6%, escalate to CEO and correct the operating cause.

rows.definition: Good phones requiring replacement divided by Good phones tested in the same relevant batch. Keep batch counts and tracker version.
rows.boundary_type: March EBITDA zero holding all other base inputs
rows.proposed_action: At 50%, audit supplier lots and tester calibration; near 55.06%, rerun sourcing and margin economics before accepting further lots.

T28.title: April trade-in ramp, setup payment and recovery

inputs.assumption: A15: new next-quarter growth funding; April launch restarts the case ramp at 1000. Keep B1+B2 and February third shift running. No second B1/B2 setup charge. Months after August held at 4000.

definitions.ongoing_ebitda_lakh: contribution after marketing minus 58 company fixed minus 9 shift, before C setup
definitions.incremental_ongoing_ebitda_lakh: ongoing EBITDA minus keep-plan ongoing EBITDA
definitions.setup_cash_lakh: 35 in April, zero thereafter; under case convention also deduct from April EBITDA
definitions.month_ebitda_after_setup_lakh: ongoing EBITDA minus setup in that month
definitions.cumulative_incremental_benefit_after_set: sum incremental ongoing EBITDA since April minus one-off 35
definitions.payback: first cumulative nonnegative month; fractional estimate assumes within-month incremental benefit accrues evenly, not a promised cash-flow forecast

T28.payback_method_correction: Inherited 2.2 months holds first-month incremental benefit constant. Ramp-aware cumulative incremental recovery occurs during May, interpolated about 1.75 months. Never divide setup by total company EBITDA.

T29.title: Material assumption alternatives and consequences
T29.inputs: All alternatives hold remaining exhibit inputs fixed. Rejected readings diagnose model errors and are not permitted Q1 strategies.

definitions.April scope: post-Q1, requires fresh funding and explicit ramp assumption
definitions.compliance: B1 screen is conditional; removing the proxy cannot demonstrate compliance or price missing controls
